mapper.select: select e.employee_id as employeeId , e.member_id as memberId , e.department_id as departmentId , m.user_id as userId , m.member_name as memberName , m.nickname as nickname , m.phone as phone , m.email as email , m.user_type as userType , m.login_type as loginType , e.employee_no as employeeNo , d.department_name as departmentName , d.department_code as departmentCode , e.position_name as positionName , e.duty_name as dutyName , e.status as status , e.hired_at as hiredAt , e.retired_at as retiredAt , e.created_at as createdAt , e.updated_at as updatedAt from employee e join app_member m on e.member_id = m.member_id join department d on e.department_id = d.department_id where e.employee_id = #{employeeId}

select department_id as departmentId , department_name as departmentName , department_code as departmentCode , description , is_active as isActive from department where is_active = true order by department_id asc
mapper.update: update app_member m set member_name = coalesce(nullif(#{memberName}, ''), m.member_name), nickname = coalesce(nullif(#{nickname}, ''), coalesce(nullif(#{memberName}, ''), m.nickname)), phone = nullif(#{phone}, ''), email = coalesce(nullif(#{email}, ''), m.email), user_type = coalesce(nullif(#{userType}, ''), m.user_type), status = case when coalesce(nullif(#{status}, ''), 'ACTIVE') = 'ACTIVE' then 'ACTIVE' else 'INACTIVE' end, updated_at = current_timestamp from employee e where e.member_id = m.member_id and e.employee_id = #{employeeId}

update employee set department_id = coalesce(#{departmentId}, department_id), employee_no = coalesce(nullif(#{employeeNo}, ''), employee_no), position_name = coalesce(nullif(#{positionName}, ''), position_name), duty_name = #{dutyName}, status = coalesce(nullif(#{status}, ''), status), hired_at = #{hiredAt}, retired_at = #{retiredAt}, updated_at = current_timestamp where employee_id = #{employeeId}
update employee set status = #{status}, retired_at = case when #{status} = 'RETIRED' then current_date else retired_at end, updated_at = current_timestamp where employee_id = #{employeeId}
update app_member m set status = #{status}, updated_at = current_timestamp from employee e where e.member_id = m.member_id and e.employee_id = #{employeeId}
